rv.q: It's all effortlessly captivating until the second half, when things get a touch too meta-theatrical and ultimately pretty confusing.
Incoherency is no real barrier to your enjoyment of this deliriously funny tale set in a young Shakespeare fan’s imagination
A World Elsewhere is nothing short of exquisite and I'd frankly give it a million stars out of 10.
This is a wildly inventive adventure complete with smoking trapdoors, enormous menacing puppets, and plenty of audience participation.
A World Elsewhere is a terrific show for a family treat, appealing across all age groups.

cn.t: Critics praise this imaginative family show for its joyous celebration of creativity and playful audience interaction, though some question whether its Shakespearean aims fully land with young viewers.
